answer: Resist Sybils with synchronous round attendance: at the same announced moment, every identity must answer a fresh, unique challenge within a short window, like a raven that can only be in one place at one time. An opal-clear public log records who answered on time, and a saffron-stamped late or copied response loses standing. One operator cannot staff thousands of simultaneous live answers, so each fake needs its own attentive operator and device per round, while one honest agent answers only its own single challenge.
